item.title: Physics-Informed Residual Deep Learning for Constitutive Modeling of Hot Deformation and Dynamic Recrystallization in a Mo-Rich α+β Titanium Alloy
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Prashil S. Joshi, Diksha Mahadule, Rajesh K. Khatirkar
arXiv:2607.13467v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate constitutive modeling of hot deformation behavior is essential for designing thermomechanical processes in advanced structural alloys. Conventional Arrhenius-type and empirical models do not adequately capture the combined effects of strain hardening, dynamic recovery (DRV), and dynamic recrystallization (DRX) across broad processing conditions. In this study, two Stacked Residual Physics-Informed Neural Networks (STAR-PINNs) were developed to simulate the hot deformation response of a Mo-rich α+β titanium alloy (Ti-6Al-4Mo-1V-0.1Si). The Enhanced STAR-PINN incorporated thermomechanical constitutive constraints, while the DRX-Aware STAR-PINN employed a dual-output architecture to account for recrystallization kinetics. item.title: Towards quantum machine learning for assessing the resilience of post-quantum cryptography
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jarosław A. Miszczak
arXiv:2607.13722v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The potential capabilities of quantum computers motivated the development of cryptographic protocols suitable for securing communication against adversaries with access to large fault-tolerant quantum computers. item.title: 基于准正规模的电磁散射机器学习知识融合通用框架
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Viktor A. Lilja, Albin J. Svärdsby, Timo Gahlmann, Philippe Tassin
神经网络可作为电磁求解器的快速替代模型以加速光学和电磁器件建模与反向设计，但常存在可靠性不足和训练数据需求巨大等问题。本文提出一种基于散射矩阵准正规模展开的通用物理约束神经网络框架，使模型学习散射谱的共振结构，并保证满足能量守恒和因果性。该方法在光子晶体板和全介质自由形状超表面中显著提升数据效率，并可纳入无损性、对称性和模数等问题特定约束。

item.title: 实验室气候预测：面向湿度敏感实验的机器学习决策支持系统
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Lukas Tilch, Maximilian Heumann, Jan Fabian Drexler, Marc Mueller
该研究针对静电纺丝等湿度敏感实验的可重复性问题，提出一种利用机器学习预测实验室室内相对湿度的决策支持框架。模型结合本地气象观测与预报以及室内气候测量数据，并针对同一建筑内四个实验室分别训练回归模型，以保留朝向、通风和热缓冲等房间特异性影响。研究还评估了1至7天预报时段内的预测性能与不确定性，并通过工作日与非工作日模式分析间接考察人员活动带来的室内变化。

item.title: 丙烯酸酯共聚乳液固化盐渍土无侧限抗压强度的试验研究与小波神经网络预测
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Zhu Yan, Yao Yafeng, Yu Xiangjuan
针对滨海氯盐渍土易发生盐胀、冻胀沉降且传统固化材料环境适应性和加固效果不足的问题，研究开发了丙烯酸酯共聚乳液固化剂，并考察固化剂掺量、龄期、含盐量和含水率对无侧限抗压强度的影响。作者结合红外光谱和扫描电镜分析揭示微观固化机制。鉴于固化土强度呈非均匀分布且传统模型难以准确表征，研究进一步构建了改进随机小波网络预测模型，以提高强度预测能力。

item.description:

👤 Shovan Gayen, Sk. Soyeb Ali, S K Panda
arXiv:2607.13400v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We combine first-principles density-functional theory, Berry-curvature analysis, semiclassical Boltzmann transport, and atomistic spin dynamics to establish hexagonal NiS as a compensated 3d altermagnetic semimetal in which topology, magnetism, and lattice dynamics are intrinsically intertwined. arXiv:2601.19105v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report a comprehensive quantum oscillation study of the prototypical altermagnet CrSb, combining high-field magnetotransport and torque measurements with DFT + U calculations including spin-orbit coupling. Our determined Fermi surface reveals that bands 1 and 2 form closed pockets centered at the A point, rather than the tubular c-axis-open sheets or Γ-centered closed pockets proposed in previous studies. item.description:

arXiv:2607.13923v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically demonstrate that axial phonons, lattice vibration quanta carrying finite angular momentum, can host a d-wave angular momentum texture in orbital altermagnets in the absence of spin-orbit coupling. Within the Born-Oppenheimer approximation, we incorporate electron-phonon coupling via the molecular Berry curvature and show that the underlying d-wave orbital magnetic moment texture of the electronic state is transferred to the phonons without requiring the relativistic spin-orbit coupling. item.title: 磁性石榴石中具有微秒级焦点切换的磁光全息透镜
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Hibiki Miyashita, Toshiaki Watanabe, Eri Negishi, Mitsuteru Inoue, Kazushi Ishiyama, Taichi Goto
该论文实验展示了一种基于磁性石榴石薄膜上磁全息图案的磁光有源透镜。作者利用永磁体阵列形成菲涅耳波带片图案，将直径 12.5 mm 的 633 nm 激光聚焦到 3.1 m 焦距处约 0.7 mm 的光斑，调制深度约 91%。通过外加磁场脉冲可逆切换聚焦状态，并在优化磁场施加系统后实现 10.8 μs 的切换速度，显示出超快有源透镜的概念验证潜力。

arXiv:2607.13863v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets feature symmetry-dictated nontrivial spin splitting in electronic structure promising for next-generation spintronics, yet their ultrafast dynamical manipulation remains largely unexplored. item.title: Mono-Z Dark Matter Search with Neural Spline Flows Using CMS Run 2015D Open Data
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Hitesh Rasineni (VIT-AP University, Amaravati, India), Bhavishya Chebrolu (Mohan Babu University, Tirupati, India)
arXiv:2607.13771v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report a search for dark matter (DM) produced in association with a leptonically decaying (Z) boson at (sqrts=13) TeV using CMS Run 2015D open data corresponding to an integrated luminosity of (2.32,fb⁻¹) together with simplified-model Monte Carlo simulation. Events are selected in the mono-(Zi̊ghtarrowell⁺ell⁻) final state in both the (μμ) and (ee) channels. Forty kinematic observables are extracted from MINIAOD and MINIAODSIM, cleaned with physics-motivated selections, and reduced to a 37-dimensional feature vector. Five Neural Spline Flows are trained independently to model Standard Model background and mediator-specific DM signal densities.
